CMS must support editing derivation nodes safely with audit/revision semantics.

Digital, analog, circuit-analysis, and project sections should be hidden from public navigation/home exposure but not deleted.
Data safety, backups, migrations, regression, and Git audit are mandatory before implementation/release.
